repos_data.description: Local First Ai Agent. Optimized for Local Ai models. Long context window. Proper tools callings. Runs privately on your device.
A local LLM workhorse that keeps a memory of your workday. On-device meeting notes, dictation, autocomplete, and recall for macOS. GPLv3.
Swift/AppKit terminal multiplexer for Claude Code + shell sessions

The Swiss Army Knife of Offline AI. Chat, see, speak, and generate images on your phone or Mac — GGUF LLMs, vision, Whisper speech-to-text, Stable Diffusion, tool calling, and local-network servers. Runs on your CPU, GPU, or NPU. No account, no API key, zero data leaves your device.
188+ local tools for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor & Grok — Mail, iMessage, Teams, Slack, WhatsApp, OneDrive, Google Drive, Zoom, Outlook, Office. Native macOS, 100% local, no API keys.
Private, local-first AI "life OS": any model per life-domain over a markdown vault on your machine. Council mode, open source (GPL-3.0).

The whole local AI stack in one executable: it runs and manages local AI models across every GPU, and it's a search engine you can talk to, with cited answers from your files, code, and the web. MCP server for coding agents, web crawler, TUI, CLI, REST API, Python library. No Ollama or LM Studio needed, works with both.
ClawdHome securely isolates and manages multiple OpenClaw gateway instances on one Mac.
A macOS hotkey that opens your terminal at the right repo with your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, …) already running. Free, open source, local-only.
Off Grid AI — private, on-device AI. Run open models (text, vision, image, voice) locally through one OpenAI-compatible gateway. No cloud, no accounts, no API keys.
Observability MCP server for AI agents - 89 tools to query LLM cost/errors/latency across 7 providers and operate alerts, budgets, evals from Claude/Cursor
A native macOS terminal for running AI coding agents in parallel — built on real libghostty, with persistent tmux-style sessions and a scriptable Lua/CLI control plane.

repo_meta_data.description: The god agent for solopreneurs on Mac. Opens terminal sessions it can undo, runs agent swarms, builds iOS apps, and writes its own next version for you to approve. 39 features, 79 tools, MIT, your key or a local model.
